findings.evidence: Lines 52-53 `variable {F K : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] (W : WeierstrassCurve F)` vs line 201 `variable [DecidableEq K] [W.IsElliptic]`; `CoordinateRing`/`FunctionField` are unconditional abbrevs (mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/Affine/Point.lean:90,95). Precedent for flagging this in-repo: Affine/CoordinateRing.lean:444 "Ellipticity of `W` is not needed here, and is not assumed."
findings.fix: Say "Weierstrass curve" in these docstrings, matching the module docstring's own opening ("Let `W` be a Weierstrass curve over a field `F`"); reserve "elliptic curve" for the translation results from line 201 on, which do assume `[W.IsElliptic]`.
findings.issue: `functionFieldGaloisAction` is documented as "The Galois action on the function field of an elliptic curve", but it is stated for `W : WeierstrassCurve F` with no `[W.IsElliptic]` (that instance is only introduced at line 201, after this def and all its `algebraMap`/`genericX`/`genericY` lemmas). Same misscoping at line 63 (`coordinateRingGaloisEquiv`: "coordinate ring of an elliptic curve") and in the title at line 13 ("elliptic-curve function fields").

findings.evidence: Docstring lines 20-23 vs PR description: "the remaining elliptic-curve-specific work is to connect the action to places, divisors, and isogenies before the pairing equivariance can be assembled".
findings.fix: State the mathematical role without the sufficiency claim, e.g. "the action on functions, together with the action on points, enters the proof of Galois equivariance of the Weil pairing; the compatibility with translation proved here is the function-side half" — as Isogeny/MulByInt/Galois.lean:41-47 does under "## Use".
findings.issue: "The function-field action and the already-defined action on torsion points are the two inputs needed to prove Galois equivariance of the Weil pairing" overclaims sufficiency and narrates future work; the PR description states that connecting the action to places, divisors and isogenies is still required before pairing equivariance can be assembled.

summary: Every public declaration is documented, but two docstring claims are inaccurate: the definitions are advertised as being about elliptic curves although they assume no `IsElliptic`, and the module docstring asserts that these two actions are all that Weil-pairing equivariance needs, which the PR description itself contradicts.
